title: Wild West
objective: Defend the Wild West town from waves of outlaws while collecting gold to build mines, hire deputies, and upgrade defenses.
controls: Drag a virtual joystick anywhere on screen to move the cowboy; shooting outlaws in range and spending gold on pads happen automatically.
core_loop: Move near outlaws to auto-shoot them, collect dropped gold and minecart payouts, and step onto glowing pads to build or upgrade town defenses.
features: Virtual joystick movement with auto-aim shooting
Gold Mine construction and passive minecart gold delivery
Escalating outlaw waves with heavy enemies
progression: Outlaw waves grow larger and include tougher heavy enemies, while build pad costs scale up from 200-270 gold to 300, 400, and 1,050 gold as new areas and upgrades unlock.
hook_idea: At t=63.0s, a giant glowing whiskey glass slams down and shatters into 'DEPUTIES' while the cowboy blasts a swarming wave of outlaws at the fence.
